message:
Fluent setup rejected:
  turb-compress-mod?: compressibility correction is not implemented; opt in with --approximate compressibility to run without the turbulence compressibility (dilatation dissipation) correction; effect: validation/results/case_coverage/REPORT.md#compressibility-bound
  ke-source-mod/ke-time-marching?: undocumented Fluent k-epsilon solver switches; opt in with --approximate ke-options to run the documented standard k-epsilon (TG 4.3.1) without these undocumented Fluent k-epsilon solver switches; effect: validation/results/case_coverage/REPORT.md#standard-k-epsilon-elbows
  rp/ke-source-mod: unsupported: active model flag is not in the model allowlist
  rp/ke-time-marching?: unsupported: active model flag is not in the model allowlist

issues.label: k-omega model controls
issues.explanation: Fluent uses this switch or coefficient in the turbulence closure. Kutta implements the explicitly validated SST variants only; the requested or unparsed variant cannot be reproduced. Adapter detail: inactive model flag retained; does not apply to the selected viscous model.

issues.label: SST model controls
issues.explanation: Fluent uses this coefficient or switch in SST production, blending or destruction. Kutta requires the implemented coefficient set and finite positive limits; other model controls are not adapted. Adapter detail: inactive model flag retained; does not apply to the selected viscous model.

issues.label: SST wall omega treatment
issues.explanation: Fluent selects a wall-omega correlation or a tabulated law. Kutta implements the correlation only; the alternative table is unavailable. Correlation face-omega offset was about 0.42% on the saved Fluent 22.2 elbow fields; this is not a flow-solution error bound. Adapter detail: inactive model flag retained; does not apply to the selected viscous model.

issues.label: Energy equation
issues.explanation: Fluent solves temperature or enthalpy. Kutta omits energy; it is decoupled from momentum only when all active density and viscosity laws are constant. Temperature results are unavailable. Adapter detail: energy ignored (decoupled): constant density and viscosity.

issues.label: Turbulence compressibility correction
issues.explanation: Fluent adds dilatation dissipation to the turbulence equations. Kutta solves constant-density flow without it and will run only when you opt in with --approximate compressibility. the omitted dilatation dissipation relative to dissipation is 2k/a^2 (Sarkar, TG 4.3.8); for the elbow_param and elbow-2 air elbows, Fluent's saved k_max 9.99 m^2/s^2 and the ideal-gas sound speed 346.9 m/s at the coldest saved 299.4 K bound it by 1.7e-4; other cases need their own bound.
issues.measured_effect: the omitted dilatation dissipation relative to dissipation is 2k/a^2 (Sarkar, TG 4.3.8); for the elbow_param and elbow-2 air elbows, Fluent's saved k_max 9.99 m^2/s^2 and the ideal-gas sound speed 346.9 m/s at the coldest saved 299.4 K bound it by 1.7e-4; other cases need their own bound

issues.label: k-epsilon solver options
issues.explanation: Fluent enables k-epsilon solver switches whose equations are not documented. Kutta solves the documented standard k-epsilon model and will run only when you opt in with --approximate ke-options. not isolated, because the switches are undocumented; elbow_param CPU cold start versus Fluent's converged saved fields, with compressibility also omitted: velocity L2 0.93%, pressure L2 6.37%, k L2 9.08%, epsilon L2 17.59%, pressure-drop error 0.91%; combined solver discrepancy, not an isolated error or a general bound.
issues.measured_effect: not isolated, because the switches are undocumented; elbow_param CPU cold start versus Fluent's converged saved fields, with compressibility also omitted: velocity L2 0.93%, pressure L2 6.37%, k L2 9.08%, epsilon L2 17.59%, pressure-drop error 0.91%; combined solver discrepancy, not an isolated error or a general bound
